hooks.name: Tool change checklist
hooks.description: When a tool module under app/tools changes, remind the agent to keep the MCP tool contract, registration, and tests in sync.

action.prompt: A tool module under app/tools/ changed. Verify the MCP tool conventions still hold: (1) each public tool returns a dict or list[dict] and uses the {"error": ...} sentinel on failure, never raising; (2) any new tool is registered in app/server.py under the correct phase block; (3) the matching tests/test_<module>.py covers both success and error shapes with network I/O mocked. Point out anything missing.
